+title: 'MTP: chunked prompt prefill that feeds the drafter for each chunk'
+---
+## What
+`MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.init` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.swift) sets `mtpPrefill.stepSize = Int.max` and `.unchunked` when `drafter.requiresPromptPrefill`. The target then runs the full prompt in one forward pass and emits one hidden row for each prompt token. For a long prompt the peak memory is very large, and the benchmark of a long system prompt cannot use MTP.
+
+Prefill the prompt in chunks of `parameters.prefill.stepSize`:
+- [ ] In `MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.prepare`, run the target on each chunk with `mtpEmitFlagKey`. After each chunk, call the drafter append (the API from the parent task) with the chunk tokens shifted by one and the chunk hidden rows. Keep the last hidden row as the pending hidden for the next chunk. Report `prefill.progress` for each chunk.
+- [ ] Remove the forced `stepSize = Int.max` / `.unchunked`.
+- [ ] Do not keep the hidden rows of earlier chunks alive (evaluate the drafter cache and the main cache after each chunk, as `TokenIterator` prefill does).
+- [ ] Check that `Qwen35TextModel.forward` with `emitDrafterState` and a non-empty cache gives the hidden rows of the chunk only (Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/Qwen35.swift ~1191).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Chunked MTP prefill (stepSize 64 on a prompt of more than 300 tokens) gives the same greedy tokens and the same drafter cache contents (within float tolerance) as unchunked prefill.
+- [ ] Peak memory during the MTP prefill of a prompt of 4000+ tokens with stepSize 512 is lower than unchunked (measure with `Memory.peakMemory`).
+- [ ] `qwen38FourBitMTPGeneration` decode tok/s: no regression against the baseline (±3%).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests/Qwen35MTPTests.swift: chunked against unchunked token equality and drafter-cache equality, on the random fixture.
+- [ ] A test that the progress callback is called one time for each chunk.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38
\ No newline at end of file
